title: Inference for conditional Fr\'echet means via Riemannian Robust Bias Correction
abstract: arXiv:2611.01857v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We develop an intrinsic framework for inference on conditional Fr\'echet means with predictors and responses taking values in finite-dimensional Riemannian manifolds. We derive a second-order expansion of the smoothing bias, represented in the tangent space via the logarithm map, and show that this bias can affect first-order inference. We propose Riemannian robust bias correction (RRBC), which estimates the leading smoothing bias using a local quadratic regression in the response tangent space and corrects the estimator through the exponential map. Our leave-one-out (LOO) covariance estimator uses intrinsic displacements between the full-sample and LOO RRBC estimates, accounting for the variability of the estimated bias correction and its covariance with the local linear estimator. We establish asymptotically valid pointwise confidence sets and simultaneous confidence tubes without undersmoothing. Simulations on spheres and symmetric

translated_title: 基于黎曼稳健偏差修正的条件Fréchet均值推断
translated_abstract: 我们开发了一个内在框架，用于对预测变量和响应变量取值于有限维黎曼流形的条件Fréchet均值进行统计推断。我们推导了平滑偏差的二阶展开式，该展开通过 logarithm 映射在切空间中表示，并证明该偏差会影响一阶推断的有效性。我们提出黎曼稳健偏差修正（RRBC）方法，该方法利用响应切空间中的局部二次回归估计主导平滑偏差，并通过指数映射对估计量进行修正。我们的留一法（LOO）协方差估计量利用全样本估计与留一RRBC估计之间的内在位移，同时考虑了估计偏差修正的变异性及其与局部线性估计量之间的协方差。我们建立了渐近有效的逐点置信集和同步置信管，且无需进行欠平滑。在球面和对称（空间）上的模拟实验……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出黎曼稳健偏差修正（RRBC）方法，通过对平滑偏差进行二阶展开估计与指数映射修正，在无需欠平滑的条件下实现了黎曼流形上条件Fréchet均值的渐近有效逐点置信集与同步置信管推断。
en_tdlr: We propose Riemannian robust bias correction (RRBC), which estimates and corrects the second-order smoothing bias via local quadratic regression and the exponential map, enabling asymptotically valid pointwise confidence sets and simultaneous confidence tubes for conditional Fréchet means on Riemannian manifolds without undersmoothing.
